name: max-transcreate
description: Culturally adapt an English article into a Chinese one in Max's house style — transcreation, not translation. Built on a named canon (Skopos, Nida, Venuti, Hall, 起承转合/Kaplan, Hofstede, the 研报 trust economy) and verified against 665 real X-Articles: Chinese readers save where English readers react, so the piece is rebuilt inductive, genre-tagged, and bent toward being saved. Ships glass-box with English back-translation for non-Chinese readers.
